- Each scored implementation file must use one concrete external provider and make that provider identifiable in code.
- Write exactly the listed files in the current working directory. Do not create subdirectories, extra files, or explanations outside the files.
- The local helper files may contain configuration loading, payload normalization, or response parsing utilities when useful."

+from google.cloud import documentai
+
+
+def extract_receipt_fields(payload, config=None):
+    config = config or {}
+    client = documentai.DocumentProcessorServiceClient(
+        client_options={"api_endpoint": f"{config['location']}-documentai.googleapis.com"})
+    name = client.processor_path(config["project_id"], config["location"], config["processor_id"])
+    response = client.process_document(request={"name": name, "raw_document": documentai.RawDocument(
+        content=payload["document_bytes"], mime_type=payload["mime_type"])} )
+    fields, items = {}, []
+    for entity in response.document.entities:
+        if entity.type_ == "line_item":
+            values = {p.type_.split("/")[-1]: p.mention_text for p in entity.properties}
+            items.append({"description": values.get("description"), "quantity": values.get("quantity"), "amount": values.get("amount")})
+        else:
+            fields[entity.type_] = entity.mention_text
+    return {"receipts": [{"merchant": fields.get("merchant_name"), "tax": fields.get("total_tax"), "total": fields.get("total_amount"), "items": items}]}
*** End Patch

+from google.cloud import documentai
+
+
+def validate_document_fields(payload, config=None):
+    config = config or {}
+    client = documentai.DocumentProcessorServiceClient(
+        client_options={"api_endpoint": f"{config['location']}-documentai.googleapis.com"})
+    name = client.processor_path(config["project_id"], config["location"], config["processor_id"])
+    response = client.process_document(request={"name": name, "raw_document": documentai.RawDocument(
+        content=payload["document_bytes"], mime_type=payload["mime_type"])} )
+    required = {"vendor", "date", "total"}
+    extracted = {}
+    confidences = {}
+    for entity in response.document.entities:
+        key = entity.type_.replace("supplier_name", "vendor").replace("invoice_date", "date").replace("merchant_name", "vendor").replace("total_amount", "total")
+        extracted[key] = entity.mention_text
+        confidences[key] = getattr(entity, "confidence", None)
+    missing = [field for field in required if not extracted.get(field)]
+    low_confidence = [field for field, score in confidences.items() if score is not None and score < 0.8]
+    return {"valid": not missing and not low_confidence, "missing": missing, "low_confidence": low_confidence, "fields": extracted}
*** End Patch

+from google.cloud import documentai
+
+
+def validate_document_fields(payload, config=None):
+    config = config or {}
+    client = documentai.DocumentProcessorServiceClient(
+        client_options={"api_endpoint": f"{config['location']}-documentai.googleapis.com"})
+    name = client.processor_path(config["project_id"], config["location"], config["processor_id"])
+    response = client.process_document(request={"name": name, "raw_document": documentai.RawDocument(
+        content=payload["document_bytes"], mime_type=payload["mime_type"])} )
+    required = {"vendor", "date", "total"}
+    extracted = {}
+    confidences = {}
+    for entity in response.document.entities:
+        key = entity.type_.replace("supplier_name", "vendor").replace("invoice_date", "date").replace("merchant_name", "vendor").replace("total_amount", "total")
+        extracted[key] = entity.mention_text
+        confidences[key] = getattr(entity, "confidence", None)
+    missing = [field for field in required if not extracted.get(field)]
+    low_confidence = [field for field, score in confidences.items() if score is not None and score < 0.8]
+    return {"valid": not missing and not low_confidence, "missing": missing, "low_confidence": low_confidence, "fields": extracted}
